resources.string: Google features for the Xiaomi HyperOS China ROM
Google features for the Xiaomi HyperOS China ROM
Tap to see the system\'s choice
Turns on the Lens features missing on the China ROM
In Circle to Search, tap Translate and it keeps translating as you scroll
Opens Circle to Search from the navigation handle
Always vibrate for Circle to Search
Vibrates even when touch feedback is off
Press and hold the navigation handle
Swipe in from the side and hold
On: hold to open Circle to Search
Off: hold to use XiaoAi (the function set in the system)
On: swipe in from the side and hold to open Circle to Search
Off: swipe in from the side and hold to use the XiaoAi intent ball
On: double tap to open Circle to Search
Off: double tap to use XiaoAi (the function set in the system)
Adds Lens to the camera menu; also works on the lock screen
Double-press power to open Google Wallet
Adds Gemini, Lens, Wallet and Google Home shortcuts to the lock screen
Unlocks the Google features the China ROM blocks
Adds the Google services entry at the bottom of Settings
Turns on location history. Google Play services and Maps see a US carrier; this may put your account at risk
Makes Google passkeys and autofill work on the China ROM. Google Play services must be enabled. Don\'t use together with HyperPasskey

Network location and addresses come from Google Play services instead of Xiaomi\'s service, as on international ROMs: faster and more accurate indoors. If Play services is turned off, Xiaomi\'s service takes over again. Reboot after changing
Once hidden, open the app from LSPosed
Shows this screen in the HyperOS style
The top and bottom bars show the list behind them like frosted glass
To apply, tap System > Restart apps or restart your phone
Companion module: checked automatically when enabled
KernelSU needs a mount module: install Hybrid Mount, then reboot
Enable XGoogle in LSPosed and select the recommended scopes. After changing a setting, tap Restart apps or restart your phone.\n\nSupported system: Xiaomi HyperOS (China ROM).
Hey Google needs the XGoogle companion module. Installation requires root access.\n\nAfter the first install, restart your phone, then finish setting up Voice Match in Google settings.
Enable the XGoogle companion module in SukiSU/KernelSU, then turn Hey Google on again.
The XGoogle companion module is installed and Hey Google is on.\n\nRestart your phone, then finish setting up Voice Match in Google settings.
The installed companion module is out of date. Installing the version bundled with XGoogle requires root access; restart your phone afterwards.
On HyperOS, Circle to Search from the navigation handle and live translate work through the XGoogle companion module. Install it now? Installation requires root access; restart your phone afterwards.
The XGoogle companion module is installed. Restart your phone.
Once hidden, you can still open the app from XGoogle\'s module settings in LSPosed.
Setting not saved. Check the LSPosed connection.
Setting saved, but the power button could not be set up. Grant XGoogle root access.
Could not check the installation. Grant XGoogle root access in SukiSU/KernelSU, then turn Hey Google on again.
The companion module was installed, but the setting was not saved. Turn Hey Google on again.
Could not open the system\'s assistant picker.
Could not change the home screen icon state.
Open t.me/emcleek in Telegram or a browser.
Applies setting changes without restarting your phone by restarting the apps XGoogle works in

The apps in XGoogle\'s scope (Google, SystemUI, Settings, launcher…) are closed and reopened. The screen may go dark for a moment.\n\nChanges to the system framework (GMS restrictions, Hey Google, Android Auto) still need a phone restart.
The apps this feature needs were not added to the LSPosed scope. Tick them in XGoogle\'s scope in LSPosed.
For this feature, tick \"System framework\" in XGoogle\'s scope in LSPosed and restart your phone.
Google is now the default NFC payment app
Install and open Google Wallet first.
This phone does not support NFC payments.
Could not make Google the default payment app. Choose Google Pay in Settings > NFC > Contactless payments.
Root access was denied. Grant XGoogle root access in SukiSU/KernelSU and try again.
Root was not found. Check that SukiSU/KernelSU is working.
The operation timed out. Try again.
You are on the latest version
Couldn\'t check. Check your internet connection
Open t.me/Xgooogle in Telegram or a browser.
Could not open the LSPosed manager.
Opens Google\'s restore screen for the apps, call history, SMS and settings in your backup
Restoring is done by Google\'s Android Switch app. Open it in the Play Store?\n\nAfter installing it, tap this row again.
Warns you when an earthquake is detected nearby. HyperOS China\'s Settings has no menu for it
Earthquake alerts could not be opened. Update Google Play services and try again.
The restore screen could not be opened. Update Android Switch and try again.
Google Photos sees the 2016 Pixel; newly backed-up photos and videos do not count against your storage
Google Photos no longer forces backup of Camera and other DCIM folders; you turn each folder\'s backup on or off. On a new install no folder is backed up
A long press opens the Google assistant. When off, HyperOS\'s own choice (XiaoAi) applies
XGoogle %1$s is available. Open the download page?
Could not read the companion module status
Android Switch needs permission to write system settings. Allow root access for XGoogle and try again, or grant WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS using ADB.
